text:
Ravi (Support): Heads up — two customers reported the same request about per-tenant rate limits exposing per-tenant SLA metadata. Tickets INC-5421 and INC-5499. Can we merge and respond with a single ask?
Jamie (PM): Thanks. Do we have overlap in acceptance criteria?
Sofia (Sales): Both customers ask for admin-visible SLA label and per-tenant throttling controls; one asks for dashboard, other via API.
Ravi (Support): Yep. Ticket snippets: INC-5421: 'need SLA tag in admin UI'  INC-5499: 'API to set tenant SLA for burst capacity'
Alex (ProdOps): I'd suggest we tag as `dup-cluster:tenant-sla`, priority=P2, owner=product@team, and collect usage examples.
Jamie (PM): Agree P2. Assign to me for scope definition. @Maria can you estimate engineering effort for a dashboard + API?
Maria (Eng): Quick gut check: dashboard UI + API endpoint + auth checks ~ 5-7 dev days + QA, maybe 2 weeks end-to-end. Need clarification on quantization of SLAs (binary vs tiers).
Jamie (PM): Good point — ask support to gather exact ask: tier vs boolean. Ravi, can you confirm with customers?
Ravi (Support): I'll ping both now. Suggested reply to customers:
> Hi — thanks for reporting. We're consolidating related requests under a single roadmap ticket (PRD-2023). Can you confirm whether you need discrete SLA tiers (gold/silver/bronze) or just a single 'priority' flag? We'll follow up with ETA once scoped. :pray:
Anyone want to tweak before I send?
Sofia (Sales): Add: 'If you need tighter SLAs we can discuss dedicated capacity options' — one-liner.
Jamie (PM): Nice. Also add ETA range: 'tentative 2-4 weeks to scope, 6-8 weeks to delivery if prioritized'
Alex (ProdOps): Tagging policy: add labels 'customer-ask', 'dup-merged', 'prio-p2', 'requires-usage-sample'
triage-bot: Ticket PRD-2023 created and linked -> INC-5421, INC-5499
Jamie (PM): I'll own PRD-2023, will post initial scope doc by EOD tomorrow. Ravi pls send the acknowledgement now.
Ravi (Support): Sent to both. Copy of message: 'Thanks — we've consolidated your requests under PRD-2023. Please confirm tiers vs flag. We'll update you after scoping.' :sent: 
Sofia (Sales): Thx. I'll flag to CSMs for one customer.
Maria (Eng): Once Jamie posts scope, I'll update with rough breakdown.
Jamie (PM): Closing the thread for now, keeping it linked to PRD-2023. React with :white_check_mark: when you see the PRD posted.
